onsite_status.description: Describes whether the movement is 'onsite' or 'offsite', if set to onsite the 'scanned_out' field is unset

print_kiosk_id.description: ID of the kiosk which has shared badge pass printing enabled. Not mandatory.

lacp_id.description: Location access point ID. Not mandatory.

zone_id.description: ID of the zone being signed into. Not mandatory.

zone_other.description: Zone note for this movement. Not mandatory

scanned_in.description: Scanned in note. Only set when onsite_status = 'onsite'. Not mandatory.

scanned_out.description: Scanned out note. Only set when onsite_status = 'offsite', gets unset when onsite_status = 'onsite'. Not mandatory.

visiting_staff_id.description: ID of staff member being visited. Not mandatory.

cardnumber.description: Sign in card number. Not mandatory.

carpark_question.description: Can be set as either 1/0 or true/false. Not mandatory.

other_pass.description: Any other pass that might need to be submitted. Not mandatory.

sp_purpose.description: Reason for contractor visit. Not mandatory.

assistance.description: Whether or not a contractor requires assistance. Not mandatory.

loneworker.description: Describes whether or not the contractor is working alone. Not mandatory.

so_staff_id.description: Staff safety officer ID. Not mandatory

so_spm_id.description: Contractor manager safety officer ID. Not mandatory
